'''Saya Ksi''' was an outcast [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who established themselves as an influential [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] clan leader. At some point following the conclusion of the [[Ruusan campaign|Battle of Ruusan]], Ksi came together with the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] [[Keekrim Pon]], [[Teesoo]] and [[Thrassk]] to resurrect the defunct [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] of old as the "New Bounty Hunters Guild," in an effort to revitalize the bounty-hunting profession. Together, Ksi, Pon, Teeloo and Thrassk authored the [[Bounty Hunters' Creed]], the guiding principles for members of the new guild.<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
